meta.governance: All figures are mobilisation goals or calculated targets from SOURCE B. Not achieved results.

lede: The brief asks for a Durga Puja launch that invites India and global / NRI supporters to seed Integrated Farming pilots. Nothing below is money already raised, farmers already enrolled, or a live payment.
notice: These numbers are an ambition from the Krishak Samaj brief. They are not a live campaign dashboard.

stats.label: farmers we want to support
stats.body: A planned cohort, not a current enrolment count.

stats.label: constituencies in the sketch
stats.body: The brief says approximately 295 constituencies and about 15 people per constituency. That arithmetic is not presented as an Election Commission map. Existing public research records 294 assembly constituencies in West Bengal.

stats.label: seed funding per farmer (goal)
stats.body: A seed-funding target so a farmer can begin an Integrated Farming pilot in their locality. Not a disbursement record.

stats.label: implied funding requirement
stats.body: 5,000 farmers × ₹1,00,000 per farmer = ₹50 crore. This is derived arithmetic, not money in hand.

how.body: Supporters in India and overseas, including NRI donors, are named in the brief as the intended audience. This website does not collect donations, UPI, bank details, or tax-benefit claims. If a real donation system is later approved, it should plug into Participate without rewriting this story.
